remarks: Welcome to 7 Hamilton Avenue unit 32, a captivating urban retreat in the heart of South Norwalk where comfort meets unparallel convenience. This exquisite residence features 2 generously sized bedrooms, a pristine bathroom and open floor plan with oversized balcony offering an ideal layout for modern living. This unit has been fully renovated and thoughtfully designed to maximize space and natural light, creating an inviting atmosphere from the moment you step inside. Enjoy the exceptional ease of living with two dedicated parking spots and the sought-after luxury of in-unit laundry, simplifying daily routines and adding to your peace of mind.
